page.notes: Left margin notes: "Edsardus à Carolo Geldro auxilia petit." (beside "tiens ad Carolum") and "Caroli artes." (beside "versuti princeps"). Both are printed in smaller italic type. Doubtful: "peffun-data" at the line break is read as "peffun-" with a hyphen that may be a period; the rest of the line break is uncertain. "Ed-fardus" is joined from the line break. "essèt" and "Frisiâ" are kept as printed. Printing error or doubtful spelling: "Edsardi" and "Edsardus" are printed without a space in "tribusEdsardi". The faint "Digitized by Google" line at the bottom right is omitted as a digitiser's mark.
